label: trades athletes to team
definition: Sports team X transfers an athlete to team Y through a sporting player trade.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit team-to-team player trade; historical athlete transfer by trade. Excludes: playing against the other team; ordinary trade of goods or territorial transfer; a player joining a team without an identified trading team; mere proposal or interest without a trade. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: trade-to with omitted object and unresolved athlete-transfer context; unclear sending versus receiving team; trade talks or future proposal without realization. The athlete is a third role. Clear team-to-team player-trade context can establish the action without naming the player; otherwise retain the omitted-object uncertainty.
